scenes.title: The Seiji token never reaches the agent

cues.text: Symphony keeps the Seiji token in a Secret.
The agent gets SEIJI_TOKEN. That is its own session token, not Seiji's.
cues.say: The agent gets seiji token. That is its own session token, not Seiji's.

cues.text: SEIJI_URL points at the gateway, not at Seiji.
cues.say: Seiji U R L points at the gateway, not at Seiji.

cues.text: The gateway checks the session token. Then it sends the stored token to Seiji.
It does this for MCP calls and for the HTTP API: uploads, evidence files, and /v1/me.
cues.say: It does this for M C P calls and for the H T T P API: uploads, evidence files, and the me route.

cues.text: It rewrites Seiji's links to the gateway, so the agent can follow them.
Viewer pages take no token, so the gateway does not proxy them.
